g.text: Two real lattices for |a| < 13/6. At each endpoint they merge into one degenerate wave.
Beyond |a| = 13/6 the two lattices are complex conjugates and leave this real plane.
Lattice of the full twisted period group Γ · Real invariants do not alone imply a bounded real profile.
